question: Who was the captain of the Indian women's cricket team for World Cup-2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mithali Raj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India skipper **Mithali Raj** broke the record for most matches **captained in the ICC Women's Cricket World Cup 2022**. 
 
• She went past Australian legend Belinda Clark for the most matches in the Cricket World Cup. 
 
• Clark had captained her side in 23 matches. 
 
• She had completed 150 ODIs as India's captain during the game against New Zealand recently and holds the record for most matches as captain in all ODIs as well. 
 
• Interestingly, Mithali and Clark are the only two cricketers to have led their country at more than two World Cups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Shafali Verma
 
 
The BBC Emerging Player award was presented to 18-year-old cricketer Shafali Verma, who has recently been playing at the Women's World Cup in New Zealand.

 
 
 

 Smriti Mandhana
 
 
India opening batter Smriti Mandhana won the Rachael Heyhoe Flint Award for the ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year for 2021. 

 
 
 

 Harmanpreet Kaur
 Harmanpreet Kaur becomes India's first winner of the** ICC Women's 'Player of the Month**' courtesy of her leading role in her team's first ODI series victory in England since 1999.
